original_test_intent: Verify that a fully populated SUT completes exactly five OS reboots while retaining every expected device and producing no BMC/OS errors, hang or blue screen.
original_method: Bind the supported reboot method and complete inventory, preserve baseline, issue one approved reboot at a time, verify shutdown/boot/BMC/OS readiness and inventory after each cycle, and stop on any anomaly.
manual_activity: The owner approves the disruptive five-cycle sequence, workload/final state and recovery policy; an operator maintains console/OOB intervention authority.
required_inputs: Exact SUT/OS/BMC and full CPU/DIMM/HDD/GPU/NIC inventory
Preserved log baseline and per-cycle collectors
safety_requirements: Require approval and clean active state
Issue only one reboot per verified cycle
Stop on boot timeout, hang, blue screen or device loss
Do not convert failure to power cycle automatically
agent_execution_scope: Issue approved OS reboot one cycle at a time
Track request, shutdown, POST, OS/BMC readiness and inventory
Stop on anomaly without autonomous recovery or verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Inapplicable: physical PSU removal belongs to row 800 and does not execute an OS reboot.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the supported OS reboot controller exactly five times, gated by full recovery and inventory after each cycle.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Five reboots, full population, no-error/no-hang/no-blue-screen/no-device-loss criteria, script and 30/60-minute fields remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Run five individually gated request-shutdown-boot-readiness-inventory cycles.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact method, per-cycle state machine, evidence and stop/recovery rules.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: PSU presence/status service provides no reboot or OS device-persistence evidence.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Repeated reboot may expose boot, storage, firmware, driver or enumeration faults.

project_override_considerations: Warm reboot, graceful OS reboot and BMC reset are not interchangeable; the project must select the source-consistent OS reboot semantic and record any uncovered reset class.
expected_evidence: Approval, target/version and full inventory baseline
Per-cycle reboot request and shutdown/boot timestamps
Per-cycle logs, sensors and device inventory comparison

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Row 1522 consistently defines five reboots. The same-code PSU service case is a separate variant and its copied DeepSeek action is rejected.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Reboot method, timing, inventory and recovery are finite project inputs, enabling attended automated execution.

review_improvement: Reclassifies the case from copied physical PSU service to the actual approval-gated five-reboot state machine with per-cycle device persistence.
independent_technical_reasoning: A reboot loop is automatable, but each cycle must be causally closed before the next begins. Counting commands without verified boot/readiness and inventory would hide accumulated or intermittent failure and violate the source criteria.
